description: This source file is a FastAPI application that provides backend API endpoints for managing templates and roles within a career platform. It sets up API routes, database models, dependency injection for database sessions, startup tasks including optional seed data, and API documentation metadata.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing templates in the database.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing roles in the database.

classes.name: TemplateCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a template.

classes.name: TemplateOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for outputting template data.

classes.name: TemplateUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a template.

classes.name: RoleCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a role.

classes.name: RoleRead
classes.description: Pydantic model for reading role data.
